'''Discharge Nozzles''' were components used on weapons such as the [[Ssi-ruuvi ion paddle beamer]] and [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]]. Four Discharge Nozzles were located just behind the paddle beamer's [[Beam Emitter]]. On flamethrowers, such as the [[Model C-22 flame carbine]] and [[CR-24 Flame Rifle/Legends|Model CR-24 flame rifle]], the Discharge Nozzles were used to project the flame from the weapon.<ref name="EGWT" />
